about.text: Skimmed milk run through an ultrafiltration membrane, often with water added to wash more lactose out, and then dried: a powder of 40 to 90 % milk protein that has the casein and whey proteins in the ratio of milk. Used in protein drinks, yoghurts, bars and to raise the protein in cheese milk.

facts.v: MPC35 to MPC85 and MPI, by protein in dry matter
